speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction and a history of easy bruising; please describe when you first noticed these symptoms and if there is a family history of similar issues. To help narrow this down, how many days has the bleeding lasted, and has it stopped spontaneously or required pressure?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details. Given your age, the family history of bleeding and joint swelling in your uncle, and the poor response to pressure, I suspect a coagulation factor issue rather than a platelet disorder. When was the last time you had a significant nosebleed or cut that wouldn't stop quickly?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A.

Based on the isolated elevation of your PTT (60 sec) with a normal PT and platelet count, alongside your family history of male relatives with joint swelling, you have classic signs of a Factor VIII deficiency. I am requesting images of any joint swelling you may have to confirm the presence of hemarthrosis.
